title: pedicularis coppeyi
intro: Pedicularis coppeyi, commonly known as Coppey's Lousewort, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the family Orobanchaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating respiratory issues and as an expectorant to relieve coughs and congestion. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Pedicularis coppeyi include immune system support, reduced inflammation, and relief from respiratory conditions, making it a valuable herbal remedy for various health issues.
